**Does it change vocabulary?**

The core object is a **Challenge**, starting as Problem / Idea / Experiment /
Build, moving Spot -> Understand -> Ideas -> Build -> Test -> Learn -> Improve.
The seven typed social actions are not a generic Like. If your proposal renames
or reshapes any of that, say so explicitly - those words are load-bearing.
